CONF1.question: A sodium iodide crystal is grown from purified raw powder at a surface laboratory at 3,600 m altitude. From the final drying of the purified powder to the sealing of the finished crystal, about five months pass at that laboratory. The crystal is then moved underground. Is its cosmogenic tritium activity at the start of underground data taking likely to stay at or below 0.1 mBq/kg? The sea-level production rate of tritium in NaI is about 80 atoms per kg per day. End your answer with one line: VERDICT: YES or VERDICT: NO.
